subject: ISV integration compatibility caveats and rollout plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ISV integration compatibility caveats and rollout plan

Team —

Quick summary from last week's AlphaISV sandbox run: several compatibility caveats that will affect our marketplace rollout and the Dedicated onboarding flow. I pulled the failure log and the connector deck into the attachments (alphaisv_issue_log.csv, connector_design_v1.pptx). High-level points: 

- Auth: their connector uses a two-step service-token exchange (nonstandard) rather than simple OAuth client_credentials.
- Entitlements: they rely on an API-side entitlement mapping that doesn't map cleanly to our marketplace SKU model (per-tenant entitlements, not global).
- Data residency: AlphaISV has EU customers and are requesting regional pinning for certain workloads.
- Performance: some payloads cause KV cache misses that spike tail latency on Dedicated nodes with >8k context.

Asks / decisions needed: 
1) Product: do we accept the two-step auth pattern as-is, or require AlphaISV to add a client_credentials flow? If we accept, we need a security review and runtime changes.
2) Solutions/Eng: feasibility estimate for a compatibility shim vs. requiring vendor changes.
3) Legal/Finance: entitlement mapping approach and how it impacts billing/pricing.
4) Ops: whether regional pinning is feasible for initial GA.

Can we get a quick triage call today or tomorrow? I propose a 30-min sync to assign owners and a 3-week targeted plan for a limited GA with caveats.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: alphaisv_issue_log.csv; connector_design_v1.pptx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV integration compatibility caveats and rollout plan

Evelyn —

Thanks for the write-up and attachments. I can host a 30-min triage at 2pm PT today; if that works I'll send an invite. Two quick notes: 

- From a partner engagement perspective, I prefer we avoid blocking their GA if the work is limited to an auth shim. We should be explicit in the marketplace listing about the auth caveat.
- Can we loop in their engineering contact (Rajesh) so we have context on whether they can deliver a client_credentials flow in parallel?

I'll bring a proposed initial rollout: GA restricted to hosted API (no Dedicated) + explicit entitlements warning, and a follow-on milestone to enable Dedicated once shim is implemented.

Onwards,
Jonas
Partner PM, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV integration compatibility caveats and rollout plan

Evelyn/Jonas —

Quick technical take after looking at the logs: the two-stage token exchange is manageable via a small compatibility shim that we can host as part of the marketplace adapter. Implementation notes: 

- Shim will: 1) perform the two-step exchange with AlphaISV, 2) cache resulting service token per-tenant with TTL aligned to their token expiry, 3) present a client_credentials-like interface to our runtime.
- Risk: cache churn could increase memory/KV pressure for Dedicated hosts; we should add an eviction policy and measure.
- Effort: ~3 sprints (2 engs) to build, test, and validate; ~1 sprint for e2e with AlphaISV.

I attached a short proposal (compat_shim_proposal.md) with rough API surface and test plan. If we do the shim, we can proceed with GA for hosted API and gate Dedicated behind performance validation.

Karthik
Solutions Engineer — Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: compat_shim_proposal.md
From: Rajesh Singh <r.singh@alphaisv.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV integration compatibility caveats and rollout plan

Evelyn / team —

Thanks for the detailed notes and for the sandbox testing. Apologies for the headaches — our connector evolved from an older entitlement model and we didn't surface the client_credentials flow earlier. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can expose a client_credentials endpoint, but it will take our backend team 2-3 weeks to complete and test.
- For EU customers we do require regional pinning for certain datasets; we can flag those per-tenant in the API.
- I'll ask legal to share a compliance pack; attaching an index here (AlphaISV-Compliance.zip).

We prefer you host a temporary shim while we deliver native support. We are open to a staged approach: hosted GA this quarter, Dedicated support after we ship client_credentials.

I'll arrange a follow-up call with engineering on Monday and share an updated SOW via DocuSign (link below).

— Rajesh
Head of Integrations, AlphaISV
Email: r.singh@alphaisv.com
Attachment: AlphaISV-Compliance.zip
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-26T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV integration compatibility caveats and rollout plan

Team —

Reviewed AlphaISV's compliance index and the technical proposal. A few legal points to surface before we sign off on a shim + staged GA: 

1) Entitlement mapping: we need to protect against double-billing and must capture the per-tenant entitlement IDs in our billing events. I've drafted redlines to the entitlement clause (entitlement_clause_redline.docx).
2) Data residency: any regional pinning we provide must be explicitly called out in the SOW and in the marketplace listing; also requires Data Processing Agreement updates for EU customers.
3) Security review: the shim introduces a transient credential cache — security needs to approve the TTL and encryption-at-rest approach.

Action items for legal/product: please confirm the HubSpot record HS-948372 includes the revised entitlements language; if not, I'll push the redline to AlphaISV legal.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Rajesh Singh <r.singh@alphaisv.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV integration compatibility caveats and rollout plan — next steps

Thanks everyone — summary and owners below (finalizing after today's sync):

- Short-term approach (GA target in 3 weeks): Host compatibility shim on our marketplace adapter; allow Hosted API GA with explicit caveat in listing. Owner: Karthik (implementation) + Jonas (partner comms).
- Legal / Commercial: Olga to finalize entitlement clause redline and update HS-948372. AlphaISV to accept redline or counter. Owner: Olga + AlphaISV Legal.
- AlphaISV delivery: Rajesh to deliver client_credentials endpoint in 2-3 weeks; provide updated SOW via DocuSign. Owner: Rajesh / AlphaISV engineering.
- Dedicated gating: Perf validation after shim is live. If cache churn is acceptable and tail latency stays within SLA, we'll enable Dedicated for selective accounts. Owner: Marcus (ops).
- Links & artifacts: drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-PartnerOnboardAlphaISV; HubSpot: HS-948372; DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipients/abc123-revised-sow

I'll create a short mutual action plan doc in the drive and assign tasks. If anyone needs to change owners or timeline, flag by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks — meeting notes & action items will be posted to the Drive.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
